ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 20

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

4. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

6. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 7

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

8. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 30
   C. 36
   D. 18

11. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 18

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

13. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

19. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 19
   C. 17
   D. 7

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

23. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
